description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the Android build system, including retrieving various directory paths based on environment variables and ensuring the existence of paths.

methods.name: GetTop()
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the Android build root, raises AbortError if not found.

methods.name: GetHostOutDir()
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the Android host output directory, raises AbortError if not found.

methods.name: GetOutDir()
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the 'out' directory of the build, defaulting to 'out' under the build root if environment variable not set.

methods.name: GetHostBin()
methods.description: Computes and returns the absolute path to the host binary directory, raises AbortError if directory does not exist.

methods.name: GetProductOut()
methods.description: Returns the full path to the product output directory, based on environment variable.

methods.name: GetTargetNativeTestPath()
methods.description: Returns the full path to the native test directory within the product data.

methods.name: GetTargetSystemBin()
methods.description: Returns the full path to the system bin directory within the product output.

methods.name: GetHostLibraryPath()
methods.description: Returns the full path to the host Java library output directory.

methods.name: GetTestAppPath()
methods.description: Provides the path to the test application build output directory.
